auteur: Shereen Shoukry Hunter, Dina Omar Helmy, Naglaa Aly Zayed, Tamer Mohamed El-Tayeb, Magdy Amin El-Serafy
description: Micrograph of eosinophilic esophagitis . Intraepithelial eosinophils (58 eosinophils) were detected. Of notice also is the intercellular edema giving the spongy or moth eaten appearance (hematoxylin and eosin stained section, original magnification ×200).
